email.subject: Quick note on Polar Heating & Cooling's site
email.body:
Hi Ravi,

I checked out Polar Heating & Cooling's site. Two things are likely costing you calls: it isn't set up for mobile, so most Harbor Falls searches (done on phones) probably bounce before they see your number, and there's no reviews section, which matters a lot when people are comparing HVAC companies. The footer's also out of date and hours aren't listed, so visitors can't tell if you're open.

I fix sites like this for a flat fee. Happy to walk you through exactly what I'd change in a free 10-minute call, no pitch, no pressure.

Worth a quick look?

Alex
Northlight Web
